stories.headline: Finastra Sells Core Banking Business to Focus on Payments and Lending
stories.body: Private capital asset manager Pollen Street plans to acquire Finastra’s global core banking software business, Universal Banking (UB), and support UB as it becomes a standalone business. Pollen Street will provide investment to UB to help the company accelerate product innovation, strengthen customer delivery and expand capabilities, the companies said in a Friday (June 19) press release.
